// Length boundaries. A "text string" has 14 or more static characters (escapes decoded, every ${...}
// hole counts 0). A "long" one has more than 180. The number on each line is that static length.
export const A = '01234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789' // 200: text, long
export const B = '0123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890' // 181: text, long
export const C = '012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789' // 180: text
export const D = `012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789${n}0123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890` // 181 without the hole: text, long
export const E = `012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789${n}012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789` // 180 without the hole: text
export const F = 'abcdefghijklmn' // 14: text
export const G = 'abcdefghijklm' // 13: below the floor
export const H = `${first}${second}abcdefghijklm` // 13 without the holes: below the floor
export const I = `${first}abcdefghijklmn` // 14 without the hole: text
export const J = `${anIdentifierThatIsSoLongThatTheRawTemplateIsLongerThanOneHundredAndEightyCharactersButItsStaticTextIsEmptyAndHolesCountZeroSoItIsNotATextStringAtAll}` // 0: nothing
export const K = '\u0061\u0062\u0063\u0064\u0065\u0066\u0067\u0068\u0069\u006a\u006b\u006c\u006d\u006e' // 14 once decoded: text
export const L = '\u0061\u0062\u0063\u0064\u0065\u0066\u0067\u0068\u0069\u006a\u006b\u006c\u006d' // 13 once decoded: below the floor
